checks.name: class-name resolution remains one upstream interface and one closed ADT
malformed names are closed before any namespace/import projection
malformed inputs do not manufacture empty or doubled-separator class identities
inheritance adapts lexical evidence to the shared resolver rather than resolving independently
static-call/model identity consumes the exact shared class-name judgment
invocation semantic judgment remains an outcome-indexed value, not a second class resolver
existing invocation authority delegates source binding and integrated response projection
runtime executor remains a downstream execution boundary and does not own class-name resolution
no relation/foundation subscanner or parallel invocation/response/AST authority was introduced

note: Structural audit only; full TypeScript typecheck, build, and Vitest are not asserted.
